dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the visible dorsal mass from the mid-section toward the posterior tip.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white; medium-high pixel intensity indicating a sub-adult or near-mature skin phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters distributed across the mid-dorsal and right-lateral regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the light-grey baseline and the faint pigmented mottling.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, linear, high-contrast white marks (scratches) visible on the left side and a single small white circular spot on the right lateral margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of superficial linear rake marks across the dorsal surface, likely resulting from intraspecific social interaction.
